newsitem.title: USA: FOB GULF GRAIN-SOY OFFERS MOSTLY UP, CORN MIXED.
newsitem.headline: FOB GULF GRAIN-SOY OFFERS MOSTLY UP, CORN MIXED.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers were mostly higher on Monday while corn values were mixed.
Soft red winter and hard red winter wheat were unchanged.
The continued volatility of August/November spread on the Chicago Board of Trade has affected FOB prices, one dealer said.
"It is frustrating to try to trade," he said.

On the export front, Taiwan is likely to tender for up to 128,000 tonnes of corn this week along with a small cargo of 10,000 tonnes of soybeans after futures prices on the Chicago Board of Trade rose last week, traders said on Monday.
